features.name: Task Creation
features.description: Users can create new tasks with title and description.
user_stories: As a user, I can create a new task so that I can track my work.
As a user, I can add a description to my task so that I remember details.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the task page, When I click create and enter a title, Then a new task is saved.
Given I create a task, When I submit without a title, Then I see an error message.

features.name: Task Completion
features.description: Users can mark tasks as complete or incomplete.
user_stories: As a user, I can mark a task as complete so that I know it is done.
As a user, I can unmark a completed task so that I can reopen it if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have a task, When I click the complete button, Then the task is marked as complete.
Given a completed task, When I click unmark, Then the task returns to incomplete status.

features.name: Task Deletion
features.description: Users can permanently delete tasks they no longer need.
user_stories: As a user, I can delete a task so that I can remove unwanted items.
As a user, I can confirm deletion so that I do not accidentally remove tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given I select a task, When I click delete and confirm, Then the task is removed from the list.
Given I click delete, When I cancel the confirmation, Then the task remains in the list.

features.name: Task List View
features.description: Users can view all their tasks in a list format.
user_stories: As a user, I can view all my tasks so that I see what needs to be done.
As a user, I can see completed and incomplete tasks separately so that I can focus on pending work.
acceptance_criteria: Given I open the app, When the page loads, Then I see a list of all my tasks.
Given I have tasks, When I filter by status, Then I see only completed or incomplete tasks.

relationships.notes: Each task belongs to one user

assumptions: Users must be authenticated to create and manage tasks
Tasks are soft-deleted or permanently removed based on business requirements
Task completion status is a simple boolean flag
Timestamps use server timezone or UTC
